atoms.proposition: A velocity statement is incomplete for this family until object and reference frame are identified.
atoms.micro_check: Label the object and observer for each velocity arrow.

atoms.proposition: At release in Galilean inertial frames, ground-frame object velocity equals object-relative-to-launcher velocity plus launcher-relative-to-ground velocity.
atoms.micro_check: Construct the ground-frame launch vector from two labelled vectors.

atoms.proposition: Projectile component equations begin after the launch velocity has been expressed in the chosen frame.
atoms.micro_check: Resolve the combined launch vector into ux and uy.

atoms.proposition: After release, horizontal and vertical ground-frame motion share one elapsed time.
atoms.micro_check: Write x(t) and y(t) using the same t.

atoms.proposition: In the standard projectile model, gravity changes vertical velocity while inherited horizontal velocity remains constant.
atoms.micro_check: Identify which velocity component gravity changes.

atoms.proposition: Setting launcher speed to zero must reduce the model to ordinary stationary-source projectile motion.
atoms.micro_check: State the launch vector when platform velocity is zero.

atoms.proposition: A moving-launcher problem requires frame conversion before ordinary projectile kinematics.
atoms.micro_check: State and justify the first move for an unseen moving-launcher setup.
